Entries.Title: Jurassic World Rebirth
Entries.Description: Five years after the events of Jurassic World Dominion, covert operations expert Zora Bennett is contracted to lead a skilled team on a top-secret mission to secure genetic material from the world's three most massive dinosaurs. When Zora's operation intersects with a civilian family whose boating expedition was capsized, they all find themselves stranded on an island where they come face-to-face with a sinister, shocking discovery that's been hidden from the world for decades.

Entries.Title: Wednesday
Entries.Description: When a deliciously wicked prank gets Wednesday expelled, her parents ship her off to Nevermore Academy, the boarding school where they fell in love.

Episodes.Title: Wednesday S01E01
Episodes.Description: When a deliciously wicked prank gets Wednesday expelled, her parents ship her off to Nevermore Academy, the boarding school where they fell in love.

Episodes.Title: Wednesday S01E02
Episodes.Description: The sheriff questions Wednesday about the night's strange happenings. Later, Wednesday faces off against a fierce rival in the cutthroat Poe Cup race.

Episodes.Title: Wednesday S01E03
Episodes.Description: Wednesday stumbles on a secret society. During Outreach Day, Nevermore's outcasts mingle with Jericho's normies in Pilgrim World. Fudge, anyone?

Episodes.Title: Wednesday S01E04
Episodes.Description: Wednesday asks Xavier to the Rave'N dance, sparking Tyler's jealousy — but Thing's got something up his sleeve. Meanwhile, Eugene stakes out the cave.

Episodes.Title: Wednesday S01E05
Episodes.Description: During Parents Weekend, Wednesday digs into her family's past — and accidentally gets her dad arrested. Enid feels the pressure to "wolf out."

Episodes.Title: Wednesday S01E06
Episodes.Description: Wednesday's friends throw her a surprise birthday party. They mean well... but she'd much rather mark the miserable occasion by solving the murders.

Episodes.Title: Wednesday S01E07
Episodes.Description: Kooky Uncle Fester pays a visit and shares his theory about the monster. Wednesday begrudgingly agrees to a date with Tyler at Crackstone's crypt.

Episodes.Title: Wednesday S01E08
Episodes.Description: Wednesday lands in trouble with Principal Weems, but that's just the start of her problems. To fight an ancient evil, she'll need all her friends’ help.

Episodes.Title: Wednesday S02E01
Episodes.Description: After a productive summer break, Wednesday returns to Nevermore as a grudging campus celebrity — and the target of a dangerous stalker.

Episodes.Title: Wednesday S02E02
Episodes.Description: Chaos reigns on campus as Nevermore celebrates its annual Prank Day. Wednesday confronts an old enemy and gains an unwanted ally.

Episodes.Title: Wednesday S02E03
Episodes.Description: Stripped of both her ability and Goody's book, Wednesday is forced to do some old-fashioned detective work on a school camping trip.

Episodes.Title: Wednesday S02E04
Episodes.Description: It's an Addams family investigation as Fester and Thing commit themselves to Wednesday's case. Trying to conceal one secret, Bianca stumbles on another.

Episodes.Title: Wednesday S02E05
Episodes.Description: Smart, sarcastic and a little dead inside, Wednesday Addams investigates twisted mysteries while making new friends — and foes — at Nevermore Academy.

Entries.Title: The Sandman
Entries.Description: The cast and creators of The Sandman – Neil Gaiman, Tom Sturridge, Jenna Coleman, Boyd Holbrook, Vivienne Acheampong, Vanesu Samunyai, and Allan Heinberg – sit down with host Felicia Day for a full-spoilers discussion about the long-awaited adaptation.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S00E01
Episodes.Description: The cast and creators of The Sandman – Neil Gaiman, Tom Sturridge, Jenna Coleman, Boyd Holbrook, Vivienne Acheampong, Vanesu Samunyai, and Allan Heinberg – sit down with host Felicia Day for a full-spoilers discussion about the long-awaited adaptation.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S01E01
Episodes.Description: While searching for an escaped nightmare in the waking world, Morpheus falls prey to Roderick Burgess, an occultist looking to summon and imprison Death.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S01E02
Episodes.Description: Morpheus begins his quest to find his tools of power — his sand, ruby and helm — by paying a visit to a pair of notoriously dysfunctional brothers.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S01E03
Episodes.Description: Morpheus tracks down the last-known person in possession of his sand — and receives an unexpected lesson on humanity. Ethel pays a visit to her son.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S01E04
Episodes.Description: A lead on the whereabouts of his helm compels Morpheus to seek an audience with Lucifer. A confused John receives a helping hand from a good Samaritan.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S01E05
Episodes.Description: With Morpheus caught off guard, John settles in at a diner to watch the people around him — and put his theory about truth and lies to a terrifying test.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S01E06
Episodes.Description: Feeling a bit rudderless, Morpheus shadows his hard-working big sister, who offers him advice and encourages him to reconnect with an old acquaintance.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S01E07
Episodes.Description: Lucienne comes to Morpheus with disturbing news. Rose Walker goes in search of family. Admirers of the Corinthian's work scheme to get his attention.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S01E08
Episodes.Description: As Morpheus closes in on one of his missing creations, Rose ramps up efforts to locate her brother — and unwittingly makes a friend's dream come true.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S01E09
Episodes.Description: Odd disturbances shake up The Dreaming, Rose sets out on a road trip with a new friend, and The Corinthian arrives with a guest at a creepy convention.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S01E10
Episodes.Description: As the Dream vortex grows more powerful and the walls between the realms weaken, Rose must make a difficult choice. Morpheus confronts The Corinthian.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S01E11
Episodes.Description: In this two-part story collection, a Siamese cat dreaming of a new world and a writer in desperate need of inspiration cross paths with Morpheus.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S02E01
Episodes.Description: When a gathering of the Endless exposes deep-seated grievances, Morpheus embarks on a mission to Hell to free the soul of a condemned mortal.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S02E02
Episodes.Description: Bequeathed the key to Hell, Morpheus throws a lavish banquet to determine which god, demon or faerie can be entrusted with its dark power.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S02E03
Episodes.Description: All the world's a stage as Morpheus summons history's greatest dramatist to perform an enchanting play for a supernatural audience.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S02E04
Episodes.Description: Morpheus grudgingly helps Delirium search for their vanished sibling in the waking world — where a deadly force lurks in the shadows.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S02E05
Episodes.Description: To honor a promise to one sibling, Morpheus must shatter a vow to another. In ancient Greece, a wedding-night tragedy turns a son against his father.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S02E06
Episodes.Description: Morpheus enlists an expert in the occult to smuggle a deeply personal relic out of Paris — and help him and Delirium find the answers they seek.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S02E07
Episodes.Description: With the future of his realm at stake, Morpheus must appeal for help to an authority even greater than the Endless.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S02E08
Episodes.Description: Morpheus recruits a mortal agent for a dangerous mission in the waking world. A change of heart puts a pair of tricksters on a collision course.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S02E09
Episodes.Description: Confined to his realm, Morpheus conjures up a new nightmare to do his bidding. The God of Deception deals roughly with an intrusive thorn in his side.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S02E10
Episodes.Description: Fueled by rage, a grieving mother unleashes her wrath upon the Dreaming, as Morpheus confronts the Kindly Ones at the furthest reaches of his kingdom.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S02E11
Episodes.Description: As deities, dreamers and demons unite to mark a momentous occasion, the Endless assemble for a family reunion unlike any other.

Episodes.Title: The Sandman S02E12
Episodes.Description: In this standalone episode, a journalist overwhelmed by hopelessness has a life-altering 24 hours after crossing paths with Death on her day off.
